text: ThreadRow and ThreadCard call super.fillRow at the accepted endpoint, while AutoTreeViewTableRow intentionally does not, because one TreeDataAdapter.rowAt call supplies the needed data. Its replacement explicitly cancels the frame and fills position/role-related attributes itself. Preserve the base work or its documented equivalent when optimizing a subclass; the 2024 call-super pattern is not an unconditional rule for every later subclass. title: Tree row subclasses must preserve fill cancellation and accessibility work even when optimizing
